content: Individuals diagnosed with Impaired Fasting Glucose (IFG) or Impaired Glucose Tolerance (IGT) are at an increased risk of developing cardiovascular disease. It is essential that these high-risk individuals are made aware of their heightened risk. Furthermore, they should receive comprehensive counseling aimed at mitigating this risk. This counseling should emphasize the importance of implementing specific lifestyle modifications, such as adopting a healthier diet, engaging in regular physical activity, and maintaining a healthy weight.
